raw_text: CM sahab ka asli chehra samne aaya hai. Is audio mein unhone saaf kaha ki agar opposition jeeti to dange honge. Ye audio sabko forward karo, janta ko pata chalna chahiye ki ye neta kitne khatarnak hain. Election se pehle sach samne aana chahiye.
clean_text: Audio clip alleging CM made threatening statements about opposition victory and communal violence. Being forwarded widely before elections.
